mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the rate of decline in FEDFUNDS does not correlate with return spikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate below 5.2% (e.g., rising above 5.5%) indicates weakening labor market pressures, leading to reduced inflation expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in the next 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly higher when UNRATE rises above 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal occurs without subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates expanding demand across sectors, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher when both proxies rise together (Granger causality p > 0.05) or the correlation between proxies and returns is below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) indicate an accommodative monetary policy stance during a late-cycle expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher in such regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or the policy combination fails to predict returns in subsequent quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals easing monetary policy and robust demand, synergistically boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing coupled with demand expansion
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positively correlated with the combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise (Pearson correlation < 0.2) or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signal a robust labor market and stable inflation expectations, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with low inflation
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher in such regimes (Granger causality p > 0.05) or the policy combination fails to predict returns in subsequent quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past quarter reflects expanding manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher when INDPRO rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the correlation between INDPRO growth and returns is below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 points in a month signals unexpected manufacturing momentum, driving investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 2 points in a month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positively correlated with INDPRO spikes above 105 (Pearson correlation < 0.2) or the signal occurs without subsequent economic growth.
